college_of_swords.name: College of Swords
college_of_swords._note: Each blade flourish is one feature (melee/ranged variants collapsed). Pick 1 fighting style from college_of_swords_fighting_styles (Duelling or Two-Weapon Fighting only).

knowledge_domain.name: Knowledge Domain
knowledge_domain._note: L1 Blessing of Knowledge: gain expertise in 2 of {Arcana, History, Nature, Religion}. L5/6/7/8/9 unverified — fetch was truncated.

eldritch_knight.name: Eldritch Knight
eldritch_knight._note: EK uses Wizard spells, restricted to Abjuration + Evocation, plus 1 'free' wizard spell of any school per spell-pick slot. The user's spells_eldritch_knight pool already pre-filters to Abjuration/Evocation L0-L2. The 'free' choice uses spells_wizard. L2 spell slots unlock at L8 in BG3.
